subject: design/workbench-ui-v1
statement: The class registry chooses one read-only presentation for each document class. Markdown classes are presented by a Go `html/template` path that emits navigable headings and anchors while escaping document content; plans call the existing Go plan-viewer package over the folded model. If a registered presentation is unavailable, the entry stays in the catalog with its metadata and a named remedy replacing the page (PRD UB-2). Degradation is per-document and loud, never a blank page or dead server.
